units.source_text: 登山家也好，大楼擦玻璃窗的也好，电视塔上的电工也好，

en.t: Whether he is a mountain climber, a man cleaning the windows of a tall building, or an electrician up on a television tower,

units.source_text: 马戏团的空中飞人也好，发电厂的烟囱清扫工也好，

en.t: whether he is a circus trapeze artist or a chimney cleaner at a power plant,

units.source_text: 要是被底下的事吸引去了注意力，那就到了他的灭顶之时了。

en.t: if his attention is drawn to what is below, that is the moment of his destruction.
